question.html:
A beam of monochromatic light is incident on a metal plate and photoelectrons are emitted from the plate. What will lead to an increase in the momentum of the emitted photoelectrons?

  1. Increasing the intensity of the incident light.
  2. Increasing the wavelength of the incident light.
  3. Increasing the frequency of the incident light.
  4. Increasing the work function of the metal plate.
